project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Local Cadw and National Monuments Record of Wales data and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 24 directly adjoining public green-space geometries and 0 reviewed visitor extensions were included in the active visitor boundary.
